name: AnySplat
plain: AnySplat (InternRobotics): 3D Gaussian splats, cameras and depth from unposed images in one pass; saves a 3DGS .ply. MIT.
summary: AnySplat (Jiang et al. 2025): feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting from unposed, uncalibrated images. A VGGT backbone (fine-tuned aggregator, camera head and depth head) predicts the cameras and depth of every view; a DPT Gaussian head predicts per-pixel Gaussians (opacity, scale, rotation, degree-4 SH), fused per voxel into one scene (`result.gaussians`, `.save("scene.ply")`). Forward pass only: no renderer.

papers.title: AnySplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unconstrained Views

licence_notes: AnySplat's code and checkpoint are MIT; its VGGT copy (net/) is under the VGGT License (commercial use allowed). The checkpoint was fine-tuned from VGGT-1B, whose own weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0: the AnySplat authors release theirs as MIT.

Upstream's Gaussian head file (vggt_dpt_gs_head.py) carries a stale Naver CC BY-NC-SA header from DUSt3R although the class used here is new code on the VGGT DPT head; this family reimplements that head (GSHead in model.py) and vendors none of the Naver-headed files.
task_io: Input: several images of one scene (posed and calibrated for multi-view stereo, unposed otherwise). Output: depth maps and, where the model predicts them, cameras and 3-D points.

variants.name: anysplat

licence.training_note: Per the paper (arXiv 2505.23716) a mixture of public multi-view datasets; the repository ships CO3Dv2, DL3DV and ScanNet++ training configs. VGGT-1B initialisation.

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (bfloat16); InternRobotics/AnySplat@5f5e208a7dd5 EncoderAnySplat inference, long side 448, voxel_size 0.002

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

quality.title: DTU scans 1, 9, 24, 33, 75, view 24 + 7 sources, AbsRel / delta1 %
quality.protocol: 640x512 crops, the 7 most co-visible views as sources; GT = depth rendered from the structured-light points. AbsRel / delta1 over GT pixels, after per-image median scaling unless the model takes the cameras (calibrated MVS: cameras, error in mm; PatchMatchNet also the depth range 425-935 mm, MVSAnywhere its own range from the camera baselines).

original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (bfloat16); InternRobotics/AnySplat@5f5e208a7dd5 EncoderAnySplat inference, long side 448, voxel_size 0.002

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1.3e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.0013 and p99 <= 0.0033 (absolute error of the output `depth`).
